summary: Russian forces launched a wave of drone and missile attacks across multiple Ukrainian regions, including a refinery strike in Saratov and casualties in Odesa and Kyiv. Ukrainian air defenses reported intercepting numerous drones, while ground combat continued in the north-eastern direction near Kharkiv. Diplomatic and domestic developments included potential negotiation signals and internal Russian military innovations.
key_points: Russian drones attacked the Saratov oil refinery, causing a fire at the ELOU-AVT6 unit, with the regional governor confirming casualties (Source: @UkraineNow/83103).
Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 25 drones over Bashkortostan, with one downed over Ufa causing a fire, according to the republic head (Source: @tass_agency/388302).
Two children were injured in a drone attack on Odesa's Podilsky District, with both hospitalized in serious and moderate condition (Source: @UkraineNow/83087).
Seven Russian assault groups were eliminated by Ukraine's 4th Border Guard Battalion near the village of Artylne on the North-Slobuzh direction (Source: @UkraineNow/83109).
President Zelenskyy stated that Russia fired approximately 1900 drones, 1600 aviation bombs, and 144 missiles at Ukraine in one week, damaging over 1500 civilian objects (Source: @UkraineNow/83107).
A nighttime ballistic missile attack on Kyiv killed nine people and injured 28, damaging residential buildings and infrastructure in Solomianskyi and Darnytskyi districts (Source: @UkraineNow/83093).
Ukrainian experts claim Russia has begun using a new type of drone with unknown characteristics (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32102).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces conducted widespread drone and missile strikes across Ukraine, targeting critical infrastructure including an oil refinery in Saratov and residential areas in Kyiv and Odesa. Ukrainian air defenses reported intercepting dozens of drones while ground operations continued near Kharkiv. President Zelenskyy confirmed a weekly average of nearly 2000 drones and 144 missiles launched by Russian forces.
ukraine: President Zelenskyy reported that over the past week, Russia launched approximately 1900 drones, 1600 aviation bombs, and 144 missiles against Ukraine, damaging over 1500 civilian objects including hundreds of residential buildings (Source: @UkraineNow/83107).

A nighttime ballistic missile attack on Kyiv killed nine people and injured 28, causing partial collapse and fires in a five-story building in Solomianskyi District and damage to administrative and residential structures in Darnytskyi District (Source: @UkraineNow/83093).

Two children, a 12-year-old girl and her 6-year-old brother, were injured in a drone attack on Odesa's Podilsky District; both were hospitalized with the girl in serious condition (Source: @UkraineNow/83087).

Ukrainian air defenses destroyed over 445,000 aerial targets since February 2022, including 91 Kinzhal hypersonic missiles, 794 Kalibr cruise missiles, and 65,618 Shahed drones, according to Air Force data (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69625).

The Russian Orthodox Church officially approved at least 12 prayers related to the war, including a mandatory prayer for 'Holy Rus' requesting Russian victory, with clergy refusing to read it facing defrocking (Source: @UkraineNow/83108).

Ukrainian exports are being hampered or halted due to logistical disruptions caused by Russian attacks on the energy system, damaging logistics networks, warehouses, and port infrastructure (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32109).
russia: Russian forces attacked the Saratov oil refinery, operated by Rosneft, which processes around 7 million tons of oil annually and supplies the Russian military sector; the governor confirmed casualties (Source: @UkraineNow/83103).

Air defenses in Bashkortostan intercepted 25 drones during a mass attack, with one drone shot down over a Ufa industrial zone causing a fire that was still being extinguished (Source: @tass_agency/388302).

The Russian Ministry of Defense claimed its forces are using AI-guided drones that can identify Ukrainian military uniforms and unit numbers, according to a spokesperson for the 71st separate regiment of the Western group (Source: @tass_agency/388308).

Russia launched a coordinated drone offensive across multiple Ukrainian regions including Kharkiv, Dnipro, Poltava, and Chernihiv, with reconnaissance and attack drones detected moving toward key cities (Source: @eRadarrua/103741).

Russian forces targeted publishing infrastructure in Kharkiv, hitting the warehouse of the 'Morning' publishing house and the 'Bookland' bookstore chain with two guided drones, which the director called a planned destruction of textbooks (Source: @UkraineNow/83092).
eastern_front: Ukraine's 4th Border Guard Battalion eliminated seven Russian assault groups near the village of Artylne on the North-Slobuzh direction, destroying three vehicles and three enemy positions used for reinforcement and accumulation of forces (Source: @UkraineNow/83109).
Russian reconnaissance drones were detected moving from northern Chernihiv Oblast toward Kyiv Oblast, passing near the village of Oster en route to Velyka Dymerka and Brovary (Source: @kpszsu/71145).

Drone activity was reported over Kharkiv Oblast from the south, with a reconnaissance drone spotted north of Snovsk moving toward Horodni, and attack drones detected near Nova Vodolaga and Bohodukhiv (Source: @kpszsu/71148).

Russian attack drones were observed moving north from the occupied left bank of Kherson Oblast toward Zaporizhzhia, with additional drones detected near Nikopol and Kriviy Rig (Source: @eRadarrua/103726).
northern_front: Air raid alerts were activated in Kyiv at 03:13 on August 2, 2026, indicating ongoing Russian aerial threats to the capital region (Source: @eRadarrua/103713).
Russian reconnaissance drones were detected north of Snovsk in Chernihiv Oblast, moving in the direction of Horodni, with air defense systems engaged to intercept them (Source: @kpszsu/71200).
Attack drones were reported moving from Chernihiv Oblast toward Kyiv Oblast, passing near Oster and heading toward Velyka Dymerka and Brovary (Source: @kpszsu/71145).
southern_front: Russian attack drones struck Odesa's Podilsky District, injuring two children who were hospitalized in serious and moderate condition (Source: @UkraineNow/83087).
Drone activity was reported over Mykolaiv Oblast, with an attack drone detected near Bereznehuvate moving from the south (Source: @eRadarrua/103726).

Russian drones were observed over the occupied territory of Kherson Oblast and near Zaporizhzhia, with two attack drones detected near Voznesensk and one near Petropavlivka (Source: @eRadarrua/103723).
Attack drones were reported near Nikopol in Dnipro Oblast, moving northward, and another drone was detected over the southern Zaporizhzhia region moving westward (Source: @eRadarrua/103726).

Air defenses in Bashkortostan intercepted 25 drones during a mass Russian attack, with one drone shot down over an industrial zone in Ufa causing a fire (Source: @tass_agency/388302).
Two attack drones targeted Kyiv and Brovary, with air defense systems engaged to intercept them (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69623).
Russian reconnaissance drones were detected over northern Chernihiv Oblast near Snovsk, with air defense systems activated to neutralize the threat (Source: @kpszsu/71200).
key_developments: Russian forces launched a major drone and missile campaign across Ukraine, striking the Saratov oil refinery, residential areas in Kyiv and Odesa, and infrastructure in multiple regions, causing civilian casualties and fires (Source: @UkraineNow/83103).

Ukrainian air defenses reported intercepting 25 drones over Bashkortostan and destroying over 445,000 aerial targets since the start of the full-scale invasion, including advanced missile systems like Kinzhal and Kalibr (Source: @tass_agency/388302).

Seven Russian assault groups were eliminated by Ukraine's 4th Border Guard Battalion near Artylne on the North-Slobuzh direction, with three vehicles and three enemy positions destroyed (Source: @UkraineNow/83109).

President Zelenskyy confirmed that Russia fired approximately 1900 drones, 1600 aviation bombs, and 144 missiles in one week, damaging over 1500 civilian objects including residential buildings (Source: @UkraineNow/83107).
A nighttime ballistic missile attack on Kyiv killed nine people and injured 28, damaging residential buildings and infrastructure in Solomianskyi and Darnytskyi districts (Source: @UkraineNow/83093).

The Russian Orthodox Church officially approved at least 12 war-related prayers, including a mandatory prayer for Russian victory, with defrocking threats for non-compliant clergy (Source: @UkraineNow/83108).
Ukrainian experts identified a new type of Russian drone with unknown characteristics, suggesting ongoing technological advancements in unmanned warfare capabilities (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32102).
sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces continue to escalate their aerial campaign with coordinated drone and missile strikes targeting critical infrastructure, civilian areas, and military positions across Ukraine. The use of AI-guided drones and new unidentified drone types indicates advancing technological capabilities that pose increased risks to Ukrainian defenses. Ground operations remain active in the eastern and northern directions, with repeated assault attempts being repelled. The scale of attacks, including nearly 2000 drones and 144 missiles in one week, demonstrates sustained offensive pressure. Civilian casualties, particularly among children, highlight the humanitarian impact of these intensified operations.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian air defenses have successfully intercepted numerous Russian drones and missiles, though the volume of attacks continues to strain defensive capabilities. Ground forces have effectively countered Russian assault groups in the north-eastern direction, eliminating multiple enemy formations near Kharkiv. Domestically, Ukraine is addressing internal challenges such as anti-Ukrainian sentiment in Poland and conditions at the Artek children's camp. Internationally, the US has signaled potential negotiations while transferring NATO military aid coordination leadership to European allies. These responses reflect both military resilience and broader geopolitical adjustments to the ongoing conflict.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian military innovations include AI-guided drones capable of identifying Ukrainian military uniforms and unit numbers, as claimed by the 71st separate regiment of the Western group. The Russian Orthodox Church has institutionalized war-related prayers, mandating clergy to pray for Russian victory under threat of defrocking. Ukrainian intelligence sources report that many Russian drone and missile component manufacturers remain unsanctioned, enabling continued production. Diplomatic channels suggest potential negotiations may resume in coming weeks, though current military operations show no signs of de-escalation. The conflict's technological dimension is expanding, with both sides deploying increasingly sophisticated unmanned systems.
